exim4_daily_report_to.description: Email address to receive the daily activity report. Empty string disables daily reports.

exim4_daily_report_options.description: Command-line options passed to eximstats when generating the daily report.

exim4_watch_paniclog.description: Whether to monitor the panic log: 'yes' (default) sends alerts; 'no' disables; 'once' also rotates paniclog after alert.

exim4_paniclog_lines.description: Number of lines of paniclog to include in the warning email.

exim4_paniclog_noise.description: Regex pattern for lines to ignore in the paniclog (lines matching will be excluded from alert).
